summary: Seven compute-bound experiments completed in 13.1 wall-time minutes (averaging 2 minutes per experiment) based on disk-mtime fallback reconstruction, with no synthesis-only tasks. Execution was led by 'Fit calibrated source energies with matched observation budgets' at 5.39 minutes and 'Complete source producer coverage and qualify natural inputs' at 3.24 minutes, which together accounted for 8.63 of the 13.1 total wall-time minutes (65.9%), followed by three tasks at 1.21, 1.16, and 1.06 minutes. Active accelerator utilization was recorded on GPU 1 at 96% utilization and 17355MB allocated across two processes while GPU 0 was idle with 5MB allocated (0% utilization), resulting in gpu_idle_on_compute_bound_tasks recorded as false with no multi-model concurrent workloads requiring DualGPURunner.
bottlenecks_identified: The top two compute-bound experiments ('Fit calibrated source energies with matched observation budgets' at 5.39 minutes and 'Complete source producer coverage and qualify natural inputs' at 3.24 minutes) accounted for 8.63 of 13.1 total wall-time minutes (65.9%), but available records lack intra-task stage timing to profile which internal numerical optimization and coverage routines dominated execution.
Milestone timing relied on disk-mtime fallback reconstruction because the live git-log path found 0 commits, omitting structured per-task phase start/finish timestamps and execution metadata.

Accelerator telemetry represents a single point-in-time snapshot (GPU 1 at 96% utilization with 17355MB allocated and GPU 0 idle with 5MB allocated at 2026-09-29T23:42:45.918242+00:00), leaving continuous accelerator utilization and memory telemetry unrecorded across the 13.1 minutes of execution.
improvements_suggested: Implement request batching in Python inference (batching 8-16 questions per forward pass) to improve throughput on compute-bound workloads as identified in the GPU monitor report.
Add granular sub-phase timers within source energy calibration and producer coverage qualification workflows to isolate numerical fitting and validation delays.
Persist structured milestone execution receipts to eliminate fallback to disk-mtime reconstruction when git log finds 0 commits.
Sample GPU utilization, memory allocation, and temperature periodically throughout task execution to capture continuous multi-device accelerator telemetry across compute-bound runs.
